report:
Nova's Harbour Look didn't quite make it today: the island reached 87% before the light went, so it waits in the Island Log, unfinished but very nearly there.

The Sea-Glass Weave from yesterday was cut into a scarf, and a bright red beret took shape on the mannequin. Pip put in 2 careful turns at the mannequin, measuring twice and cutting once, and was heard telling the scissors to behave. Nova kept tilting the beret on her sketch, insisting red and sea-green belong together.

The Gull was moored with the red felt run still on her list, and spent the day chatting to the seagulls about tomorrow's breeze.

So close! A few more stitches and Nova will have the brightest hat on the harbour. Maybe next time it can be Pip's turn for an outfit.
